name: hands-free-voice
description: Talk to Claude Code hands-free: say "operator", talk, say "over"; it answers aloud and reads the context percent as the closer.

deepgram_api_key.title: Deepgram API key
deepgram_api_key.description: For speech to text. Kept in secure storage and handed only to the listener, never to Claude's shell.

cartesia_api_key.title: Cartesia API key
cartesia_api_key.description: For the spoken voice. Kept in secure storage and handed only to the listener, never to Claude's shell.

autostart.title: Listen at session start
autostart.description: Start listening when an interactive session starts, without /hands-free.

working_cue.title: Working cue
working_cue.description: What plays while Claude works without a word: a quiet tone, the spinner's word spoken aloud, or nothing.

working_cue_interval.title: Working cue interval
working_cue_interval.description: Seconds Claude works without a word before the cue, and between cues.

working_tone_volume.title: Working tone volume
working_tone_volume.description: The tone's loudness, as a percent of the other tones'.
